key_finding: Talen Energy is structurally an Energy Future Holdings / GenOn / Vistra / Exelon alumni operating company under a private-equity-and-restructuring-pedigree board. CEO Mac McFarland came from California Resources / GenOn / Luminant / Exelon — the post-Chapter-11 energy-restructuring CEO archetype. Chairman Stephen Schaefer brings the GenOn Holdings / Golar LNG / Riverstone / Duke Energy track record. Director Joseph Nigro (ex-Exelon CFO, ex-Constellation CEO, current Blackstone energy transition senior advisor) is the most senior single energy-finance figure on the board. Director Anthony Horton (ex-Energy Future Holdings CFO, ex-TXU Senior Director) carries the deepest EFH restructuring memory. Director Karen Hyde (retired Xcel Energy SVP/CCO; pre-Xcel nuclear engineer at DOD) is the nuclear-and-compliance audit chair. The executive team is unusually deep on nuclear (Brad Berryman as COO with 30 years nuclear and Edward Casulli as CNO from Susquehanna Site VP) and restructuring (Andrew Wright as Chief Admin Officer from 14 years as EFH General Counsel). The December 2025 management realignment elevated Terry Nutt to President and brought in Cole Muller (ex-McKinsey + Wharton MBA + US Naval Academy) as CFO, formalising the operating-and-financial leadership split as Talen scales through the AWS PPA + Cornerstone acquisition cycle.

ceo.name: Mark "Mac" McFarland
ceo.title: Chief Executive Officer and Director
career: Earlier: CEO and President, California Resources Corporation
Earlier: Executive Chairman and CEO, GenOn Energy
Earlier: Chief Commercial Officer, Energy Future Holdings
ceo.framing: McFarland is the post-Chapter-11 energy-restructuring CEO archetype. The California Resources Corporation tenure (oil and gas, also emerged from restructuring) plus GenOn Energy as Executive Chairman/CEO (power, also restructured) plus Luminant and Energy Future Holdings (the legendary EFH/TXU restructuring) plus Exelon SVP is the precise career path that produces an executive prepared for Talen's combination of post-restructuring rebuild + nuclear-fleet operation + AWS hyperscaler PPA negotiation + accelerated M&A program.

executive_team.name: Terry L. Nutt
executive_team.title: President (since December 15, 2025)
executive_team.framing: Nutt's elevation to President in December 2025 formalised the operating-and-financial leadership split. The Just Energy / EDF Trading / Vistra finance track is the appropriate operating-grade financial pedigree.

executive_team.name: Cole Muller
executive_team.title: Chief Financial Officer (since December 15, 2025)
career: Earlier: EVP Strategic Ventures, Talen Energy
Earlier: Senior VP Cumulus Growth, Talen Energy
executive_team.framing: Muller's combination of Naval Academy + Wharton MBA + UPenn JD + McKinsey associate partner is unusually deep for an IPP CFO. His prior Talen roles (EVP Strategic Ventures, SVP Cumulus Growth) mean he was the architect of the data center colocation thesis before becoming CFO. The dual operational-and-financial credential signals that the AWS PPA and Cornerstone acquisition were his initiatives before his promotion.

executive_team.framing: Wander's Vinson & Elkins shareholder litigation partnership is the deepest Texas energy-law credential available. Critical capability set for an IPP defending hyperscaler-PPA contract architecture against potential regulatory challenges.

The CPA + JD + 22 years power generation experience makes him uniquely qualified to manage the administrative and restructuring-legacy complexity that Talen carries from its own Chapter 11 emergence.

board_composition_observation: Talen's seven-director board reads: PE-and-restructuring chairman (Schaefer/Riverstone/GenOn/Golar LNG) + operating CEO (McFarland/EFH/GenOn) + Apollo+Goldman+Morgan Stanley energy banker (Abbas) + ex-EFH CFO (Horton) + retired Xcel SVP and ex-DOD nuclear engineer (Hyde) + ex-Exelon CFO and ex-Constellation CEO (Nigro) + 17-year Goldman Sachs banker now Apollo Infrastructure director (Schwartzstein). The composition is calibrated for (a) operating governance of a post-Chapter-11 IPP with a substantial nuclear portfolio, (b) execution of multi-billion-dollar M&A in a sector where deal-experience and antitrust pattern recognition matter, and (c) cycle-management through the AI-electricity infrastructure transition. There is no separate independent technologist director — this is structurally appropriate for an electricity company that sells commodity baseload, not a technology vendor.
